population_method: Native population pixels assigned once by center to stable-ID village raster and UTM grid. No valid source pixel remains null. Overlapping villages use stable last-ID wins to avoid double counting.

2019.method: Matched descending orbit, linear-power speckle mean, Otsu change threshold capped at -1.5 dB, during VV<-15 dB, slope<5 degrees, pre VV>=-15 dB water screen. Unvalidated proxy.

2021.method: Matched descending orbit, linear-power speckle mean, Otsu change threshold capped at -1.5 dB, during VV<-15 dB, slope<5 degrees, pre VV>=-15 dB water screen. Unvalidated proxy.
